deskyard share list: list an environment's shares

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] share list [ENV] [--json]

Lists the shares of an environment: who it was shared with and by, at which
level, until when, and whether they are connected now. Needs full access to
it.

Arguments:
  ENV        string      optional  environment name, or SERVER/NAME on another server; default: the chosen environment (-e, else the server's default)

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: a table NAME LEVEL SHARED-BY EXPIRES LAST-USED NOTE; with --json the
  API's [Share]

Examples:
  deskyard share list alice

Where: on this machine, talking to the environment's server: SERVER in SERVER/NAME, else the one -e SERVER/ names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
